context_budget.interpretation: A drift guard for progressive disclosure, not a semantic-completeness or owner-acceptance claim.

always_discovered.consumer: Codex skill discovery and package selection from the OS user profile
always_discovered.load_moment: before a trigger; profile package description is the selection signal
always_discovered.canonical_owner: aoa-skills profile source plus each admitted owner port
always_discovered.freshness: managed profile receipt, owner handle, and package identity
always_discovered.next_organ: selected profile package or the nearest owner route

triggered_body.consumer: the agent after a profile skill trigger
triggered_body.canonical_owner: the selected profile bundle owner; ToS carries only the route declaration
triggered_body.freshness: installed package bytes and source handle are checked by the profile installer
triggered_body.next_organ: the skill owner, validator, or refusal/return route

on_demand_reference.consumer: a triggered profile task that needs a schema, rationale, or boundary detail
on_demand_reference.canonical_owner: the selected profile package source owner
on_demand_reference.freshness: managed package identity and source handle
on_demand_reference.next_organ: return to the triggered body; hand schema authority to its named owner

on_demand_example.consumer: a triggered profile task needing a worked shape
on_demand_example.canonical_owner: the selected profile package source owner
on_demand_example.freshness: managed package identity and source handle
on_demand_example.next_organ: apply only the example's bounded shape, then use the owner contract

review_check.consumer: human or agent review of a profile-skill-shaped result
review_check.load_moment: on demand after the result exists
review_check.canonical_owner: the selected profile package source owner; checks do not replace owner review
review_check.freshness: managed package identity and source handle
review_check.next_organ: named owner review or validation lane

executable_helper.consumer: a task that explicitly needs an owner-provided helper
executable_helper.canonical_owner: the selected profile package source owner
executable_helper.freshness: managed package identity and source handle
executable_helper.next_organ: the helper contract and the owner validation lane

portable_asset.canonical_owner: the selected profile package source owner; profile copies are not local doctrine
portable_asset.next_organ: the package source owner for changes

shared_profile.consumer: Tree-of-Sophia contributors and coding agents using the selected shared OS profile bundles
shared_profile.canonical_owner: 8Dionysus/aoa-skills; repository meaning remains with the named local source or owner organ
shared_profile.freshness: profile receipt, owner source handle, and package identity; source refresh is an upstream event
shared_profile.next_organ: nearest local owner contract or the stronger AoA owner named by the selected bundle
negative_controls: Do not treat the profile receipt or installed copy as source authority.
Do not use a shared bundle to resolve a local owner boundary without that owner route.

owner_port_profile.consumer: Tree-of-Sophia owner-port pressures that need an admitted external owner bundle
owner_port_profile.load_moment: when the matching local port or runtime/artifact pressure is selected
owner_port_profile.canonical_owner: the named external owner port; ToS local ports remain intake and handoff surfaces
owner_port_profile.freshness: profile receipt and exact owner package handle; live status and receipts stay with the downstream owner
owner_port_profile.next_organ: the local port, then the named owner validator or runtime/federation surface
negative_controls: An owner-port bundle does not transfer eval, stats, KAG, memo, runtime, or artifact authority to ToS.
A same-name owner package is accepted only through its exact owner handle and profile binding.

owner_link_profile.consumer: session-memory orientation and reviewed-evidence routing for Tree-of-Sophia tasks
owner_link_profile.load_moment: when prior session evidence or compaction/recovery context is explicitly needed
owner_link_profile.canonical_owner: .aoa session-memory owner links and their named memory owners
owner_link_profile.freshness: profile owner-link receipt and current owner route; memory data remains external
owner_link_profile.next_organ: the appropriate session-memory route and reviewed owner surface
negative_controls: A memory route does not make a live session snapshot or candidate a durable fact.
Do not use a missing or stale owner-link handle as permission to search arbitrary copies.

eval_port.consumer: eval pressure intake and local-port validation before central eval selection or verdict
eval_port.load_moment: when a repository task produces or asks for eval pressure
eval_port.freshness: local route and PORT.yaml; central validator/source checkout determines shared protocol compatibility
eval_port.next_organ: aoa-evals local port validator, then central selection/proof/verdict owner

stats_port.consumer: owner-local measurement readers and aoa-stats composition
stats_port.load_moment: when a declared Tree-of-Sophia question needs a measurement or reference packet
stats_port.canonical_owner: 8Dionysus/aoa-stats for shared grammar; Tree-of-Sophia for the question and source population
stats_port.freshness: manifest, source population, route map, and evidence-linked reference packet at a named revision; reference-only, not live
stats_port.next_organ: atlas/source owner -> aoa-stats protocol validator and cross-owner composition

kag_provider.load_moment: when a portable ToS source-return export or its local verification is requested
kag_provider.freshness: ToS source-export contract and producer; consumer index state is outside this repository
kag_provider.next_organ: verified ToS source-return artifact; optional consumer import is owned outside ToS

memo_port.consumer: tree-local candidate intake and the stronger aoa-memo memory owner
memo_port.load_moment: when reviewed evidence suggests a bounded memory candidate or owner handoff
memo_port.freshness: PORT.yaml, local route docs, candidate/receipt/export posture, and generated index; no claim of durable or live memory
memo_port.next_organ: candidate-only helper -> local validator -> reviewed aoa-memo intake/decision

negative_controls: generated view is not source
receipt is not source
ADR is not a substitute for unresolved authority
do not invent a taxonomy for a clear local contract
do not move authority while mapping boundaries
do not rewrite strong surfaces without pressure
do not widen into runtime or source authority
live or unreviewed evidence fails closed
diagnosis does not mutate
repair cannot mint authority
dry-run is not authorization
approval classification is not mutation
no hidden external write
local packet is not a verdict
advisory local route is not release authority
reference snapshot is not live
ratio is not philosophical or eval verdict
local provider is not runtime graph authority
generated record does not author ToS meaning
software route validation does not check an unselected external integration
consumer checkout, skills, index validation and import are never prerequisites for ToS export or completion
candidate is not durable memory
index is not a memory decision
receipt is not a claim

companion_surfaces.role: authored profile binding, ports, and probes

companion_surfaces.canonical_owner: aoa-skills profile source and admitted owner ports

duplication_policy.local_action: Keep route probes; obtain selected owner bundles through the OS user profile without repository-local copies.
duplication_policy.canonical_next_organ: aoa-skills profile source, admitted owner ports, or the named workflow/guard owner
duplication_policy.negative_control: Do not create a local shared copy, use a deferred mode as an installed package, or infer runtime authority from the route map.

profile_binding.duplicate_boundary: Selected owner bundles are installed once through the user profile; Tree-of-Sophia has no .agents/skills projection for these shared or owner-owned procedures.
claim_limits: This declaration records profile selection and route ownership only.
It does not prove installation, fresh-session visibility, invocation, runtime health, behavioral benefit, or owner acceptance.

profile_binding_usage.contributor_check: contributor_profile_binding_issues validates declaration shape, owner references and duplicate boundaries without host discovery.
profile_binding_usage.selected_identity_check: profile_binding_issues preserves the exact admitted os-user-default v1 declaration for explicit callers.
claim_limits: A checked-in optional binding does not select, install or activate a user profile.
Contributor checks do not require sibling repositories or installed profile tools.
Consumers verify their own integration/runtime evidence separately.
